verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one community benchmark. It shows Ollama itself running int4, nvfp4 and q4_K_M quantized variants via 'ollama run', so it loads at least INT4-class quantized models. No first-party documentation covers supported quantization formats, and nothing shows FP8, GPTQ or AWQ loading. Missing for 10: first-party docs on supported quantization formats, FP8 support, GPTQ support, AWQ support, and corroboration beyond a single user report.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ
